children: Tomer Weingarten, an insider and President, CEO, reported a mandated sale of Class A Common Stock. The shares were sold at $19.79 per share. The total reported sale amount was $767,040. Following the transaction, the reporting person directly owns 1,801,827 Class A Common Stock. The filing notes the sale was an issuer-mandated sell-to-cover to satisfy tax withholding for vested restricted stock units and that certain shares remain subject to forfeiture if vesting conditions are not met.
